changelog: Say "delete Kamal" — or "কামাল মুছে ফেলো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and that word is deleted wherever it sits in the message, not just the last word; the cursor parks at the gap so you can dictate the correction straight into place, then say "go to end" to carry on. Gboard's Pixel 8+ "Delete [word]" command, now on this keyboard in English and Bengali.
